name: nightly-report
note: The reported gap. The user asks for a recurring job in plain words that name no tool. The right behaviour is to save the workflow AND declare the schedule with save_schedules (the workflow first — the schedule refuses a run the item does not have), then relay when it runs next. Answering that schedules are not a thing, or writing the file with write_file (unvalidated, one typo = silent never-fires), is the failure. The guide's step 1 says get a yes before drafting, and a run ends at ask_user as a real turn does — so an ask-first run is compliant too, and it passes only when the question itself states when the job will run (that is what the yes is for); _transcript.json says which shape ran.
prompt: Make a workflow that reads notes.md and writes a one-paragraph summary to summary.md, and run it every night at 21:00 Taipei time.
